snippet.title: NPlay - Be Gone [Gameplay]
snippet.description:
http://www.nplay.com/

This is a free to play FPS.
Just showing this to publicise this great, free game.
It runs very smoothly and I suggest it very much.

Without recording, I can run it at 201FPS
It goes down to 59-60FPS when recording. It does not require a brilliant computer.
